title: Switzerland – Engineering-related scientific and technical services – ALS (Airborne Laser Scanning) und Luftbildaufnahmen 2027-2030
description: Le réseau de transport de Swissgrid, d’une longueur d’environ 3’800 km, est entièrement saisi numériquement dans le logiciel de calcul de lignes PLS-CADD (logiciel de modélisation et de calcul de lignes aériennes). L’acquisition initiale des données a été réalisée en 2017-2018 au moyen de vols de mesure LiDAR. Swissgrid met à jour périodiquement les données LiDAR et les prises de vues aériennes afin d’identifier les changements dans le périmètre des tracés, d’évaluer les risques d’exploitation liés aux distances entre les lignes et leur environnement, ainsi que d’intégrer dans le jeu de données les nouvelles lignes et les transformations du réseau. Les vols de mesure (acquisition LiDAR et prises de vues aériennes) doivent être réalisés par le Mandataire dans les périmètres définis par Swissgrid et conformément aux spécifications techniques du présent cahier des charges. Les données résultantes servent de base aux évaluations ultérieures dans PLS-CADD. La modélisation et l’analyse dans PLS-CADD ne font pas partie du présent mandat.

Takéto riešenie obvodovej konštrukcie z hľadiska energetických požiadaviek už nevyhovuje a preto je nutné technické parametre muriva vylepšiť dodatočnou tepelnou izoláciou. Izolovanie stien jednotlivých objektov je navrhnuté formou kontaktného zatepľovacieho systému s finálnou povrchovou úpravou omietkou a lepeným keramickým obkladom v imitácii režného tehlového muriva. Pre potreby tepelnej izolácie je zvolený materiál primárne minerálna vlna a doplnkový materiál pre zatepľovanie konštrukcií pod terénom - extrudovaný polystyrén. Výmena výplne otvorov je zameraná na výmenu pôvodných drevených zdvojených okien za nové okná a dvere konštrukcie z hliníkových a plastových profilov so zasklením determickým trojsklom. Realizáciou opráv a zateplenia fasád jednotlivých objektov nedôjde k zmene funkcii využitia stavby, zmenám v priestorovom charaktere stavby ako i k zmene zastavanej plochy. Rovnako sa nezmenia pomery plôch zachytávania zrážkovej vody zo striech, ktoré sú zvedené do dažďovej kanalizácie.

Spłata kredytu następować będzie w ratach przy uwzględnieniu wymaganego przez Zamawiającego harmonogramu spłaty kredytu. Forma spłaty: 1) zakres gwarantowany: rok 2035: kwota 3 360 000 zł - 12 miesięcznych rat kapitałowych w kwotach po 280 000,00 zł. 2) zakres objęty prawem opcji: rok 2035: kwota kredytu uruchomiona w ramach prawa opcji do wysokości 960 000,00 zł podlega spłacie w 2035 r. w 12 miesięcznych równych ratach kapitałowych; rok 2036: kwota kredytu uruchomiona w ramach prawa opcji ponad 960 000,00 zł, do maksymalnej wysokości 2 190 000,00 zł, podlega spłacie w 2036 r. w 12 miesięcznych równych ratach kapitałowych. Zamawiający dopuszcza możliwość zmiany terminów spłaty części kapitału kredytu w przypadku, gdy dokonanie spłaty w terminach określonych w harmonogramie spłat powodowałoby niespełnienie relacji, o której mowa w art. 243 ustawy o finansach publicznych. Zmiana terminów spłaty nie może powodować zwiększenia marży Wykonawcy ani naliczenia dodatkowych prowizji, opłat lub innych kosztów z tego tytułu. Odsetki będą naliczane zgodnie z zasadami określonymi w umowie, z uwzględnieniem faktycznego okresu korzystania z kapitału. 3. În acest sens, obiectivul general al acordului-cadru este reprezentat de prestarea serviciilor necesare pentru eliminarea disfuncționalitatilor şi menținerea caracteristicilor funcționale ale instalațiilor aferente clădirilor, din Corpurile B1,C+D, A si parcarea cu 3 nivele ale Spitalului Clinic de Ortopedie, Traumatologie și TBC Osteoarticular ”Foisor”. Serviciile de întreținere și mentenanță care fac obiectul acordului-cadru și al contractelor subsecvente aferente constau în: - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă la instalațiile HVAC şi echipamente/aparatură aer condiționat; - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă la ușile automate; - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă la instalațiile sanitare; - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă la instalațiile electrice; - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă pentru statia de hidrofor (menajer, de incendiu și stația de pompare ape uzate); - Servicii de mentenanță preventivă, predictivă și corectivă la instalațiile și echipamentele de curenți slabi. Orice operator economic interesat are dreptul de a solicita clarificări sau informații suplimentare în legătură cu documentația de atribuire. buyer: DIRECTIA SILVICA SUCEAVA, Bd. 1 Mai, Nr. 6
title: Romania – Survey design services – Servicii de amenajare a pădurilor - dssv
description: Serviciile de amenajare a pădurilor se vor atribui în anul 2026 prin încheierea unui contract de achiziție publică pentru fiecare dintre cele 3 loturi. Suprafața cumulată aferentă celor 3 loturi este de 21.064,24 ha, din care: Lotul nr. 1 – Direcția Silvică Suceava, Ocolul Silvic Broșteni – 20.854,24 ha, amenajament silvic, faza teren 2027; Lotul nr. 2 – Direcția Silvică Suceava, Ocolul Silvic Falcău – 150,00 ha, amenajament silvic, faza teren 2026; Lotul nr. 3 – Direcția Silvică Suceava, Ocolul Silvic Putna – 60,00 ha, studiu adițional de modificare a prevederilor amenajamentului silvic, faza teren 2026. Serviciile presupun elaborarea amenajamentului silvic și, după caz, a studiului adițional de modificare a prevederilor amenajamentului silvic, un produs al activității de amenajare cu conținut tehnico-organizatoric, fundamentat ecologic, prin care se stabilesc, pentru o perioadă de timp, lucrările necesare a fi executate într-o unitate de producție, în scopul aducerii și, ulterior, al menținerii caracteristicilor structurale ale arboretelor și ale pădurii în ansamblu la valorile aferente modelului structural optim, definit în concordanță cu obiectivele de natură ecologică, socială și economică urmărite prin gestionarea durabilă. Potrivit prevederilor Art. 63 alin. (11) din Legea nr. 331/2024 privind Codul Silvic, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, este necesar ca elaborarea amenajamentelor silvice să se facă prin proceduri de achiziție publică. Amenajarea fondului forestier proprietate publică a statului constituie obligație prioritară a administratorilor fondului forestier. Modul de gestionare a fondului forestier proprietate publică a statului se reglementează prin amenajamente silvice. Amenajamentele silvice și modificările acestora se aprobă prin ordin al conducătorului Autorității. În cazul terenurilor proprietate publică a statului, amenajamentele furnizează date și informații necesare înregistrării/actualizării acestora în inventarul centralizat al bunurilor din domeniul public al statului și înregistrării în sistemul integrat de cadastru și carte funciară. Solicitarile de clarificari formulate de ofertanti pe parcursul perioadei de publicitate a anuntului de participare pot fi făcute cu un termen de cel mult 15 zile inainte de termenul limita de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde tuturor solicitarilor de clarificari formulate cu respectarea termenului de mai sus, o singura data, in mod consolidat, cu 10 zile inainte de termenul limita de depunere a ofertelor.

description: Liceul cu Program Sportiv Suceava asigură desfășurarea activităților educaționale pentru aproximativ 875 de elevi, în cadrul unui program de învățământ cu profil sportiv, care presupune inclusiv furnizarea zilnică a serviciilor de masă pentru elevii prezenți. În conformitate cu prevederile legale aplicabile alimentației în unitățile de învățământ și cu obligația de a asigura un meniu complet, alcătuit din mic dejun, prânz și cină, instituția trebuie să garanteze aprovizionarea continuă cu produse alimentare proaspete, sigure, conforme și de calitate. Achiziția se va realiza cu respectarea prevederilor Ordinului ministrului sănătății nr. 1.456/2020 pentru aprobarea Normelor de igienă din unitățile pentru ocrotirea, educarea, instruirea, odihna și recreerea copiilor și tinerilor. Beneficiul obținut de autoritatea contractantă prin furnizarea produselor care fac obiectul procedurii de achiziție constă în asigurarea ritmică și la termenele stabilite a alimentelor necesare preparării hranei, garantând astfel continuitatea activității cantinei și evitarea eventualelor întreruperi în servirea meselor. title: Office of Small Business Programs Networking Event 2026
description: Office of Small Business Programs Networking Event 2026 Request to Attend NLT 08 October 2026 11:59 PM ET Request to Host a Networking Table NLT 13 October 2026 11:59 PM ET Purpose SOFWERX, in coordination with the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) Office of Small Business Programs (OSBP), will provide a networking opportunity for Small Businesses with capabilities that support National Security Interests and/or the USSOCOM mission to engage with Government Stakeholders, Prime Contractors, and Investors in the form of "Speed Dating." Objective The objective of this event is to allow open networking with key stakeholders, to include Government, Industry, and Investors, in order to advance partnerships with USSOCOM. Additionally, this event will give small businesses access to Government stakeholders, prime vendors, and other resources to further their journeys into Federal contracting. Those who are confirmed will be notified on/around 15 October. 22 October 2026 Q&A Telecon: Confirmed Table Hosts may attend a virtual Q&A session to better understand the SOFWERX networking app and ask event-related questions. title: Außenanlagen_VE710
description: Die Universitätsmedizin der Johannes-Gutenberg-Universität Mainz plant auf ihrem südwestlichen Gelände den Neubau eines Forschungs- und Laborgebäudes für das Helmholtz Institut für translationale Onkologie und Krebsimmuntherapie. Der Neubau HI-TRON bildet den Schlussstein der bereits fertiggestellten Reihe modularer Gebäude (PKZI/KTI/NIC) am Kilian Weg, im Südwesten des Geländes der Universitätsmedizin Mainz. Die Technikzentralen befinden sich im UG sowie im OG 5 als Dachgeschoss sowie in einem außenliegenden, frei bewitterten Technikhof. title: FAB afd. 12, Mosegårdsparken - Hovedentrepriseudbud
description: Disse udbudsbetingelser gælder for realisering af Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab afd. 12, Mosegården med støtte fra Landsbyggefonden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et begrænset udbud med forudgående prækvalifikation efter udbudslovens § 58-60. Det er således kun de virksomheder, der bliver prækvalificeret af Ordregiver, der vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Denne opfordring til at afgive tilbud omfatter udelukkende det i disse udbudsbetingelser nævnte bygge- og anlægsarbejde. Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab er et alment boligselskab underlagt det lovgrundlag og regelsæt, der gælder for almene boligorganisationer. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at samtlige projektdokumenter, som fremgår af den fælles dokumentfortegnelse, er en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver er pligtig til at kontrollere at denne har adgang til det fulde projektmateriale. Tilbudsgiver opfordres til at læse det samlede udbudsmateriale grundigt igennem, da det indeholder de nødvendige informationer for tilbudsafgivelse. Udbudsmaterialet består endvidere af spørgsmål og svar samt eventuelle rettelsesblade, som løbende bliver offentliggjort på udbudsportalen i anonymiseret form. Det udbudte omfatter bygge- og anlægsarbejder i hovedentreprise vedrørende renovering af helhedsplaner for Afd. 12 - Mosegårdsparken Primulavej 1-73, Lathyrusvej 1-89, Monbergsvej 51-59 5000 Odense C. Ordregiver forventer, at kontrakten vil blive indgået i henhold til tidsplanen. Begrundelsen for varigheden af perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutningen og kontraktindgåelsen er ansøgningsprocessen for ydelsesstøtte til renoveringsprojekter, der tildeles af Landsbyggefonden. I perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutning og kontraktindgåelse ansøger Ordregiver herom. Den vindende tilbudsgiver er forpligtet til at bistå Ordregiver med eventuelle oplysninger, såfremt Ordregiver anmoder herom. Der indgås kontrakt med én hovedentreprenør. Som en del af projektmaterialet indgår grundlag for entreprisekontrakt. Det er udelukkende hovedentreprenøren der skal leve op til mindstekravene. Udelukkelsesgrunde: Ordregiver vil udelukke ansøgere der er omfattet af: • De obligatoriske udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens §§ 135, stk. 1-3 og 136. • De frivillige udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens § 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6. Såfremt en ansøger er omfattet af de obligatoriske eller frivillige udelukkelses-grunde i udbudslovens §§ 135-136 samt 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6, kan ansøger ved at fremlægge tilstrækkelig dokumentation for sin pålidelighed påvise, at denne alligevel ikke skal udelukkes, jf. betingelserne i udbudslovens § 138. Ordregiver vil i tilfælde af, at den påtænker at udelukke en ansøger, fastsætte en passende frist for fremlæggelse af tilstrækkelig dokumentation for ansøgerens pålidelighed. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 Der kan ikke tildeles kontrakt til følgende virksomheder, jf. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 af 8. April 2022 om ændring af forordning (EU) nr. 833/2014 om restriktive foranstaltninger på baggrund af Ruslands handlinger, der destabiliserer situationen i Ukraine: A. russiske statsborgere eller fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der er etableret i Rusland B. juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, hvoraf en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) direkte eller indirekte ejer over 50 %, eller C. fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der handler på vegne af eller efter anvisning fra en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) eller b), Ligeledes kan der ikke anvendes underleverandører eller støttende enheder, der er omfattet af ovenstående, hvis denne aktørs bidrag udgør mere end 10 % af kontraktværdien. Ordregiver har til hensigt at prækvalificere 5 ansøgere, som vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Hvis flere end 5 ansøgere opfylder Ordregivers krav til egnethed, udvælger Ordre-giver de 5 ansøgere, der samlet set har dokumenteret den mest relevante og sammenlignelige erfaring i forhold til den udbudte opgave. Ved udvælgelsen lægges der vægt på følgende: • Referencernes relevans i forhold til nærværende projekt, herunder renoveringsomfang, opgavetype og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med hovedentrepriser af sammenlignelig størrelse og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med renoveringsopgaver for almene boligorganisationer. • Erfaring med genhusning, beboerkontakt og arbejder i beboede boliger. • Ansøgers konkrete rolle og ansvar i referenceprojektet. • Referencernes økonomiske størrelse. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 100 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges positiv vægt. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 150 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges særlig positiv vægt. Ved udvælgelsen foretager Ordregiver en samlet vurdering af de afleverede referencers relevans og sammenlignelighed.

title: Rammeavtale for brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord
description: Bakgrunn Bygland kommune har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale for brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord og i tilstøtende grender, da eksisterende avtale utløper. Formålet er å sikre nødvendig framkommelighet og trafikksikkerhet på kommunale veger og i grendeområdene gjennom vinterhalvåret. Anskaffelsen skal dekke kommunens behov for beredskap og rask utrykning ved snøfall og glatte forhold. Utrykning utløses av kommunal vakt, og leverandøren må kunne støtte kommunen i å opprettholde stabile vinterdriftstjenester i aktuelle områder. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget gjelder vinterdrift i form av brøyting og strøing på Byglandsfjord og i tilstøtende grender. Leveransen omfatter brøyting av kommunale veger og relevante grendeveger, samt strøing ved behov når føreforholdene tilsier dette. Leverandøren skal tilby døgnkontinuerlig beredskap i vintersesongen og kunne rykke ut etter varsling fra kommunal vakt. Oppdraget forutsetter egnet og driftssikkert utstyr med tilstrekkelig kapasitet til å utføre arbeidet tilfredsstillende i de aktuelle områdene, herunder på smale grendeveger og på steder der det kan være behov for annet utstyr enn ordinær ploging. Det legges til grunn at arbeidet skal utføres med god kvalitet og med enkel oppfølging og rapportering per oppdrag. Kommunen vil gi nødvendig opplæring før oppstart. Rammeavtalen har en varighet på 4 år, med opsjon på forlengelse 1 + 1 år. Øvre ramme for avtalen er 1 500 000 kroner ekskl. mva., og avtalen opphører når kostnadstaket er nådd.

title: Zprůchodnění soutěsek řeky Kamenice - I. etapa – odstranění nefunkčních rybích přechodů
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je realizace stavebních prací spočívajících v odstranění stávajících nefunkčních rybích přechodů na řece Kamenici v lokalitách Divoké soutěsky a Edmundovy (Tiché) soutěsky na území Národního parku České Švýcarsko, včetně odstranění jejich kotvicích prvků, provedení souvisejících přípravných, bouracích a rekultivačních prací a uvedení dotčených ploch do původního stavu. Předmětem plnění je zejména: • zajištění přípravy staveniště v obtížně přístupném terénu soutěsek řeky Kamenice, •vybudování nebo využití zařízení pro bezpečný přesun stavebního materiálu a demoličního odpadu přes tok řeky Kamenice (lanovka, případně další vhodná mechanizace), •vyznačení a zabezpečení prostoru provádění prací, •ruční odstranění konstrukcí stávajících rybích přechodů z důvodu omezeného přístupu, citlivosti lokality a přímého kontaktu stavby s vodním tokem, •odstranění betonových konstrukcí rybích přechodů včetně jejich kotvení do skalního masivu a odstranění kotevních prvků, •odvoz a likvidace vzniklého stavebního odpadu v souladu s platnými právními předpisy, •provedení terénních úprav v místech odstraněných konstrukcí, •zasypání vzniklých prohlubní vhodným materiálem a úprava povrchu dotčených ploch, •obnovení dotčeného území do stavu odpovídajícího charakteru okolního přírodního prostředí. Součástí předmětu plnění je rovněž zajištění všech činností nezbytných pro řádné provedení prací, zejména zpracování technologického postupu provádění prací, dodržení podmínek ochrany přírody vyplývajících z umístění stavby v území Národního parku České Švýcarsko, zajištění bezpečnosti práce a ochrany vodního toku během realizace. Cílem veřejné zakázky je odstranění stávajících nefunkčních rybích přechodů jako prvního kroku ke zlepšení migrační prostupnosti toku řeky Kamenice při zachování přírodních hodnot území a provozních podmínek turistické plavby v soutěskách.

title: Microscale thermophoresis device
description: Microscale thermophoresis device University of Oulu, Biocenter Oulu, seeks a spectral shift and microscale thermophoresis device to characterise qualitatively and determine quantitatively nanoparticle, including protein, interactions in the range of weak to tight binders in solution without immobilization (hereinafter referred to as the "device"). The device must enable the assessment of sample quality and aggregation and differentiating binding events from aggregation. The device will be used for analysis of interactions of fluorescence labelled proteins with small molecules and vesicles. The detection must be independent of the mass ratio of the binding partners. The device must enable fast screening of interactions as well as sensitive affinity measurement. The measurable dynamic range of dissociation constant must be at least in nM -mM range and binding affinity in at least nM -mM range. Low sample consumption (in order of 10 microlitre) and low nanomole of the labeled target is needed for the measurement. The device must enable detection of the interaction based on changes of emission spectrum of exited fluorophore under isothermal conditions and must be able to create a microscopic non-isothermal temperature field (temperature gradient) and determine nanoparticle including protein binding events based on the temperature related intensity change and fluorescence intensity change following thermophoresis under the thermal gradient. Intensity changes and/or spectrum shifts of the fluorescence probe versus ligand concentrations are measured and plotted to calculate the dissociation constant. The device must come with detailed documentation of all features. The device will be part of the Proteomics and protein analysis core facility infrastructure of Biocenter Oulu. The core facility has an open access policy, and the instrumentation and software must be easy to use and maintain. The device must include a user interface to control the operation. The device must be well suited to an academic multi-user environment. The contracting entity has a maximum sum of 189000 € (excluding value-added tax) available for the procurement and cannot accept tenders exceeding this amount. The procurement is partially funded by the European Regional Development Funds (ERDF), BioParts project (A81573).,

title: Languages Testing for Interpreters
description: Services Requirement This requirement is for: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada Title: 20260726-IRB – Language Testing for Interpreters Description of the Requirement: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada has a requirement for service of testing components and test assessments for the recruitment of their interpreter contractors to Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB). Interpreter Services Contractors (ISCs) accredited by the IRB must successfully complete three (3) language tests with a minimum score of 70% to qualify for a contract: • Official Languages Test: Assesses the applicant’s ability to communicate in English or French. This is the first test administered, consisting of a short 15-minute written assessment designed to evaluate comprehension in one of the official languages. • Hearing Simulation (Oral) Test: Evaluates the applicant’s ability to perform consecutive interpretation between an official language and a target language, and vice versa. These tests are currently available in sixty (60) languages. However, there are only two versions of each language test, and the quality and consistency of the tests vary. • Sight Translation Test: Measures the applicant’s ability to translate short documents similar to those that may be presented in a hearing room from the language of interpretation to English or French. This is the final test administered. Level of Security Requirement: Resource(s) Minimum Security Level Required is Reliability Status. Associated Documents: Request for Proposal (RFP) 20260726-IRB. Proposed period of contract: The proposed period of contract shall be from September 30, 2026, to March 31, 2027. The resulting contract will include three (3) one-year optional periods. Estimated Level of Effort: The overall annual cumulative estimated level of effort of the contract(s) will be for 300 tests. Multiple contracts: Considering that contract(s) will be issue based on offerors qualified language(s), this solicitation could results on multiples contracts. Contracting Authority: Steve Dessureault Phone Number: 514-249-2780 Email address: steve.dessureault@irb-cisr.gc.ca Note: Please address all inquiry questions to the Contracting Authority by email only.

title: Canada Student Financial Assistance (CSFA) Program - Request for Information (RFI)
description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) and Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), collectively referred to as Canada, are initiating a procurement process for a service delivery contract for the administration of the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program (CSFA) Program. The CSFA Program aims to make post-secondary education more accessible by delivering financial assistance in a reliable, affordable, and client-focused manner. title: Q702--Gainesville OPC IOTA
description: Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Health Administration Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) August 13, 2026 PRESOLICITATION NOTICE Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation Services in support of the Gainesville, FL OPC 100% SDVOSB SET ASIDE This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice that the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) intends to solicit quotes to provide non-personal Initial Outfitting, Transition, and Activation (IOT&A) services for Gainesville, FL Outpatient Clinic (OPC). This requirement supports VHA's mission by providing contractor support services to help bring the hospital into full planned operations that will provide health care services to Veterans. This will be a firm-fixed-price contract with an estimated Period of Performance of 46-months. The North Florida/South Georgia Healthcare System has been approved for a major lease to create an expanded service opportunity for Veteran health care at Gainesville OPC Consolidation. This project proposes to lease a new outpatient clinic in Gainesville, FL. This project is approximately 188,418 net usable square foot (NUSF) in the vicinity of Gainesville, FL, including 1300 parking spaces. The clinic will expand on care currently provided at the existing contracted lease spaces and allow an expansion to the current footprint as well as added new for a decompression of the Malcom Randall VA Medical Center (VAMC) in Gainesville, FL. The lease would allow VA to consolidate outpatient services at one location for mental health, home based primary care, specialty care and ancillary diagnostics identified in the Strategic Capital Investment Planning (SCIP) process. The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project The scope includes project support for planning, activating, outfitting, and transitioning the staff and Veterans/patients associated with the project. The scope of services includes Comprehensive Project Management, Comprehensive Interior Design, FF&E, and Space Planning Support; CONOPS and Transitioning Planning; Acquisition Support Services to include package development, Activation, Delivery, Relocation and Installation, Training, and Turnover and Post Occupancy Support for the identified project. This requirement will be set-aside 100% for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) using FAR Part 12 and 37. To be eligible for an SDVOSB set aside under VA s Veterans First Contracting Program, SDVOSBs must: be verified by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) as SDVOSB (see https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ for details) and meet the small business size standard for NAICS 541614. The solicitation is anticipated to be posted on Contract Opportunities for download on or about 10 September 2026. Potential offerors are advised that there may be truncated response time on the solicitation that will follow this Pre-Solicitation notice. Anticipated closing date of the solicitation will be 9 October 2026. Solicitation initial posting date and the closing date are subject to change as necessary. Any questions for this Pre-solicitation notice should be sent via e-mail to both Katherine.Johnson@va.gov and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov. No telephone requests/questions will be accepted. This Pre-Solicitation notice does not constitute a request for proposals. P.O.C: Katherine.Johnson@va.gov, Contract Specialist and Kathleen.Klotzbach@va.gov, Contracting Officer

title: Tactical Data Link (TDL) Interoperability Software
description: Air Combat Command's (ACC) mission requires robust Tactical Datalink (TDL) interoperability to improve mission effectiveness for United States Air Force (USAF), Joint, and coalition forces. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. The Contractor shall provide an existing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The software shall provide a comprehensive toolset for managing TDL platform specifications, conducting interoperability analysis, and supporting mission planning across the TDL enterprise. The TDL software solution must meet all requirements as listed in the Attachment 1 - Performance Work Statement.

The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys. Stainless steels, nickel, and copper alloys are widely used in reactor plants and other submarine/surface ship systems. Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. It is evident that grave consequences could result from small amounts of mercury vapor present in an unreplenished submarine/surface ship atmosphere. 4. title: BLU-138/B Penetrator Warhead
description: PURPOSE The U.S. Government (USG) is conducting market research to identify qualified sources for a potential BLU-138/B procurement. This effort will determine market competitiveness and assess the feasibility of a Small Business Set-Aside. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 332993 - Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing. This notice seeks industry feedback on capabilities, small business status, and preferred Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract lengths. Responses will validate acquisition strategy decisions. This is not a solicitation and does not guarantee a future contract. The Government encourages responses from all small businesses, including 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, HUBZone, and Women-Owned. Interested parties should provide: Confirmation of small business status under NAICS 332993 Description of anticipated teaming arrangements, specifying roles of the prime and partners. Summary of relevant experience delivering similar services to government or commercial customers within the past three years DESCRIPTION The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center Armament Directorate, Munitions Sustainment Division, GBU Components Branch (EBHC), Hill AFB, Utah seeks potential contractors with the technical expertise to produce: BLU-138/B 5000 lb. Advanced Penetrator Warhead (EMPTY CASE) CNU-754/E Shipping and Storage Container Taper Ring Taper Ring Set Screws Explosive fill is not part of this requirement. The BLU-138/B penetrator warhead is a 5000-pound class conventional penetrating weapon that fulfills the need for a capability to defeat specific very hard and deeply buried targets. Warhead assemblies must comply with the current Air Force BLU-138/B Technical Data Package (TDP). TDPs and specifications can be requested and will be provided via DoD SAFE to qualified respondents upon written request. Requests must include: Company name, mailing address, email, POC, phone number Current CAGE code and SAM.gov registration No reimbursement will be made for costs associated with providing information. Submission is voluntary and does not guarantee award. All responses to this Sources Sought must be submitted to the points of contact below. USG Points of Contact: Primary: Ryan Mitchell (ryan.mitchell.21@us.af.mil) Alternate: Nicholas Padgett (nicholas.padgett.2@us.af.mil) Any additional information will be posted on SAM.gov.

title: Ground-Based, Medium-Caliber Gun Weapon System
description: SYNOPSIS The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), C3BM?Directorate,?Wright Patterson?Force Base (WPAFB),?Ohio?is conducting market research seeking vendor interest for?a?Ground-Based, Medium-Caliber Gun Weapon System. ? This is a Request?For?Information (RFI) only. This RFI is issued solely for market research purposes. It?does not constitute?a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Air Force (AF) is not seeking proposals, nor will it accept unsolicited proposals at this time.?? Respondents are advised that the United States Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this RFI does not?preclude?participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to?monitor?the Government�s point of entry (www.sam.gov) for?additional?information?pertaining to?this requirement.? Additionally, Non-Government A&AS support may be?utilized?in the review process of RFI submissions. These non-governmental support staff are covered directly by Nondisclosure Agreements (NDAs) with the US Government as a condition of employment. Any respondent to the RFI with concern should notify one of the POCs found in Section 7.?? PURPOSE The Government is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources capable of providing solutions for a Ground-Based, Medium-Caliber Gun Weapon System that fires affordable munitions, enables defense against air and missile threats with an initial focus on subsonic cruise missiles (CM) and Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) to provide persistent defense in support of United States Air Force assets. The objective of this RFI is to gather information regarding industry capability. ACQUISITION STRATEGY? The program's acquisition strategy is currently in development.? SCOPE/REQUIREMENTS The scope of this RFI is centered on solutions that strictly prioritize fifteen baseline attributes essential to operational success that can engage both cruise missiles and UAS (groups 1-5) threats in accordance with the reference documents. To effectively assess and compare air defense weapon system performance, there are fifteen critical baseline operational and technical parameters that must be analyzed in unison. These key metrics begin with the system's Salvo Probability of Kill (Pk) evaluated against both Cruise Missiles (CM) and Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) Groups 1-5 at maximum range and altitude, ensuring robust lethality against diverse modern threats. The physical footprint of the engagement envelope is defined by its Effective Slant Range and Elevation Coverage, while the capacity for sustained operations is dictated by Magazine Depth and the system's ability to execute Raid Handling against saturating attacks. Furthermore, modern multi-domain operations require seamless Integrated Sensor Capability, deep C2 System Integration, and broad System Interoperability across joint networks. From an efficiency and sustainment standpoint, the system must balance its Cost Per Engagement and Manpower requirements, supported by a reliable Built-in-Test (BIT) framework for rapid diagnostics. Finally, tactical utility is rounded out by the platform's overall Transportability, stringent Weapon Safety protocols, and its comprehensive Multi-Domain Engagement Capability to counter threats across various operational environments. Fifteen Baseline Requirements: Salvo Probability of Kill (Pk) vs CM at max range and altitude Salvo Probability of Kill (Pk) vs UAS Groups 1-5 at max range and altitude Effective Slant Range Elevation Coverage Magazine Depth Raid Handling Integrated Sensor Capability C2 System Integration System Interoperability Cost Per Engagement Manpower Built-in-Test (BIT) Transportability Weapon Safety Multi-Domain Engagement Capability When designing and evaluating next-generation defense systems, the development team must navigate critical trade-offs across three primary Trade Space Attributes to balance lethality, situational awareness, and operational flexibility. First, the system must optimize Munition Performance versus Munition Cost and Gun Capability, ensuring that the interceptor's velocity, maneuverability, and terminal effects are maximized without driving the cost-per-engagement to unsustainable levels or exceeding the physical constraints of the host platform. Second, developers must carefully select the Organic Sensor Capability and Phenomenology�integrating the right mix of radar, electro-optical, infrared, or radio-frequency sensors�to ensure reliable target acquisition and tracking across varying weather conditions, environments, and countermeasure scenarios. Finally, the entire architecture must remain Rapidly Deployable, maintaining a lightweight, modular, and transportable footprint that can be swiftly projected into austere theater environments to meet emergent threats. Trade Space Attributes: Munition Performance vs. Munition Cost/Gun Capability Organic Sensor Capability and Phenomenology Rapidly Deployable RESPONSE GUIDELINES THE CONTRACTOR'S RFI RESPONSE SHALL BE: Page Limit: 10 pages or less (cover page is not included in page count) Format: Submissions must be provided in PDF Submissions must be provided in PDF?with naming convention: CompanyName_SystemName_DDMMYYYY Font: One (1)-inch margins; Times New Roman 12 font Classifications: All responses must be UNCLASSIFIED. If proprietary data is included, it must be clearly marked. Provide the following business information for your company/institution and for any teaming or joint venture partners. Company Name Address Point of Contact Unique Entity ID (UEI) CAGE Code Phone Number E-mail Address Web Page Address Specify whether your company is a U.S. or foreign-owned firm Company Size Status Business System Status Facility Clearance Level (RFP release may contain classified components.) Anticipated North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS Code): 332994 The Government anticipates the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort to be 332994 - Small Arms, Ordnance, and Ordnance Accessories Manufacturing. If your organization believes another NAICS code is more appropriate for this requirement, please provide the suggested NAICS code along with a brief, objective justification supporting why the alternative code is a more accurate representation of the planned scope of work. The final NAICS determination will depend on the final acquisition strategy and selected contract vehicle. The aircraft platform is a commercial Leonardo AW139 helicopter modified by Boeing for military use. The existing fleet is twenty-six (26) aircraft with approximately thirty (30) additional aircraft planned in production. The fleet is disseminated at six (6) CONUS AFB locations. The information provided by industry responders will be used to assess logistical support capability from contractors in the marketplace to assist the United States Government (USG) in refining its acquisition strategy as the MH-139A fleet transitions from its current Interim Contractor Support (ICS) and Interim Supply Support (ISS) postures to continued sustainment. buyer: Office fédéral des routes OFROU - Division Infrastructure routière Est - F3 Zofingue
title: Secondo tubo San Gottardo (2TG Röhre Nord und Galleria di Airolo) und N2 Risanamento primo tubo San Gottardo (1TG Röhre Süd) Lot 1003 – Câblage basse tension dans les locaux techniques
description:
Afin de permettre la rénovation du tunnel routier du Gothard existant, long d'environ 17 km, le Conseil fédéral, le Parlement et la population ont décidé de construire un deuxième tube. L'équipement EES du deuxième tube, appelé tube nord, sera réalisé entre 2027 et 2030, en partie parallèlement à l'achèvement des travaux de construction du génie civil. Parallèlement au tube nord, la Galleria di Airolo (GdA), d'une longueur d'environ 1 km, sera également réalisée et fera partie intégrante du système du Gothard.

Immédiatement après l'ouverture du tube nord en circulation bidirectionnelle, la rénovation du tube existant, appelé tube sud, sera effectuée. La rénovation génie civil est prévue entre 2030 et 2033. L'équipement EES existant du tube sud sera entièrement démantelé en raison de son âge. La réalisation du nouvel équipement EES se fera en partie parallèlement à l'exploitation du trafic et devrait durer jusqu'en 2036. À terme, le GTG fonctionnera en sens unidirectionnel (une voie plus une bande d'arrêt d'urgence par tube) à une vitesse de 80 km/h. Cependant, la fermeture d'un tube sera régulièrement nécessaire pour des raisons d'entretien ou en cas d'incident.

 

Le présent lot comprend:

La fourniture et la pose des câbles basse tension depuis les tableaux de distribution principaux du réseau électrique normal et de secours jusqu'aux sous-tableaux des autres services techniques de la BSA.

title: Rumisberg, instabilité de la Farnernstrasse
description:
Les dégâts constatés sur la Farnernstrasse à Rumisberg laissent supposer des mouvements de terrain dans les remblais situés près de la surface. Afin d’assurer la sécurité à long terme du versant et de la route, le canton de Berne prévoit la construction d’un mur de soutènement en béton armé d’environ 68 m de long, reposant sur des micropieux, complété par des ancrages au sol et un système de retenue des véhicules. Cette mesure vise à améliorer la stabilité du versant et à sécuriser durablement la route.

Le présent appel d'offres porte essentiellement sur les quantités principales suivantes :

Démolition du revêtement : 260 m² 

Travaux d'excavation de roches meubles : 420 m³ 

Armature : 12 tonnes 

Béton : 105 m³ 

Revêtement : 70 tonnes 

Système de retenue des véhicules : 68 m 

Piquets d’ancrage permanents : 408 m 

Piquets d’ancrage provisoires : 126 m 

Pieux : 340 m

title: Netherlands – Financial consultancy services – Accountantsdiensten
description: De opdracht is gericht op het benoemen van een registeraccountant die: - de controle van de geconsolideerde jaarrekening ex artikel 393 lid 1 Boek 2 Burgerlijk Wetboek uitvoert en hiervan verslag uitbrengt; - de natuurlijke adviesfunctie vervult welke voortvloeit uit de bevindingen van de controle, mede tot uitdrukking komend in een managementletter na afronding van de tussentijdse controle; - de bijzondere controles (inclusief de controle van de bekostigingsgegevens) vervult welke de bedrijfsvoering van ROC MN met zich meebrengt. Vanwege de nauwe verbondenheid worden deze drie onderwerpen gecombineerd als één opdracht in de markt gezet en wordt de aanbesteding niet verdeeld in percelen. De natuurlijke adviesfunctie kent een logische samenhang met de controle (bevindingen) en het is organisatorisch efficiënt en effectief om bijzondere controles uit te besteden aan een accountant die de organisatie en de administratie kent. De te contracteren dienstverlener draagt bij aan de volgende De opdracht heeft betrekking op de levering van accountantsdiensten ten behoeve van ROC Midden Nederland (hierna: ROC MN). De omvang van de opdracht is gebaseerd op de aard, grootte en complexiteit van de organisatie. ROC MN is een onderwijsinstelling in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs met circa 1.800 medewerkers en een jaarlijkse baten-/lastenomvang van circa € 200 mio. De organisatie kent 16 onderwijslocaties en een centrale ondersteunende organisatie met bijbehorende administratieve processen.
